# Paths a change by the Cmdr M1 agents GitHub App (the headless slow-checks fixer) never lands without David's approval.
#
# One source for two readers:
#   - `ci.yml`'s `ci-ok` job (step "Sensitive paths need David's approval") reads this file from the PR's BASE commit
#     and fails `CI OK` for an App-authored PR that touches a match, until `vdavid` approves its head.
#   - `scripts/slow-checks-fixer/run.sh` pastes it into the fixer's prompt, so the agent knows before it pushes.
#
# It lives under `.github/workflows/` because the App has no Workflows permission, so GitHub refuses any push of it
# here, and the gate reads it from the base, so a PR can't loosen it for itself.
# Why each group is here and how the gate works: `scripts/slow-checks-fixer/DETAILS.md` § The sensitive-path gate.
#
# Format: one pattern per line, matched against repo-relative paths (both sides of a rename). `#` starts a comment.
#   - `dir/**`: everything under `dir/`.
#   - `**/name`: `name` at the root or in any directory.
#   - Otherwise a shell glob where `*` also crosses `/` (bash `[[ == ]]`), so `scripts/release*` covers
#     `scripts/release-finish/ci.go` too.
